text:
Items: Greek yogurt cup (~150g? label "4x150g"? likely 150g) ~ Farmers Union Greek style ~ 140 kcal per 150g... actually ~ 6.5g fat per 100g, ~95 kcal/100g → ~140 kcal.
Milk/coffee mug ~ 250ml white coffee/tea ~ 60-100 kcal; say 250g, 70 kcal.
Blueberries ~100g, 57 kcal.
Egg fried ~50g, 90 kcal.
Two slices multigrain toast ~80g, 210 kcal.
Avocado ~60g, 100 kcal.
Honey portion 12g, 37 kcal.

Total kcal ≈ 140+70+57+90+210+100+37 = 704.
Total mass ≈ 150+250+100+50+80+60+12 = 702 g.

{"kcal": 705, "mass_g": 700}
